verses.original: מַדּ֗וּעַ מִ֭שַּׁדַּי לֹא־ נִצְפְּנ֣וּ עִתִּ֑ים וְיֹדְעוֹ לֹא־ חָ֥זוּ יָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: mad·dū·a‘ miš·šad·day lō- niṣ·pə·nū ‘it·tîm wə·yō·ḏə·ʿō lō- ḥā·zū yā·māw
verses.literal: Why does the Almighty not reserve times for judgment Why may those who know Him never see His days

verses.original: יַשִּׂ֑יגוּ גְּבֻל֥וֹת וַיִּרְעֽוּ׃ גָּ֝זְל֗וּ עֵ֥דֶר
verses.transliteration: yaś·śî·ḡū gə·ḇu·lō·wṯ way·yir·‘ū gā·zə·lū ‘ê·ḏer
verses.literal: Men move boundary stones they pasture stolen flocks

verses.original: יִנְהָ֑גוּ חֲמ֣וֹר יְתוֹמִ֣ים אַלְמָנָֽה׃ שׁ֣וֹר יַ֝חְבְּל֗וּ
verses.transliteration: yin·hā·ḡū ḥă·mō·wr yə·ṯō·w·mîm ’al·mā·nāh šō·wr yaḥ·bə·lū
verses.literal: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless and take the widow’s ox in pledge

verses.original: יַטּ֣וּ אֶבְיוֹנִ֣ים מִדָּ֑רֶךְ יַ֥חַד עֲנִיֵּי־ אָֽרֶץ׃ חֻ֝בְּא֗וּ
verses.transliteration: yaṭ·ṭū ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm mid·dā·reḵ ya·ḥaḏ ‘ă·nî·yê- ’ā·reṣ ḥub·bə·’ū
verses.literal: They push the needy off the road and force all the poor of the land into hiding

verses.original: הֵ֤ן פְּרָאִ֨ים׀ בַּֽמִּדְבָּ֗ר יָצְא֣וּ בְּ֭פָעֳלָם מְשַׁחֲרֵ֣י לַטָּ֑רֶף עֲרָבָ֥ה ל֥וֹ לֶ֝֗חֶם לַנְּעָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hên pə·rā·’îm bam·miḏ·bār yā·ṣə·’ū bə·p̄ā·‘o·lām mə·ša·ḥă·rê laṭ·ṭā·rep̄ ‘ă·rā·ḇāh lōw le·ḥem lan·nə·‘ā·rîm
verses.literal: Indeed [like] wild donkeys in the desert the poor go to work foraging for food the wasteland is food for their children

verses.original: יַקְצִירוּ בְּלִיל֣וֹ בַּ֭שָּׂדֶה יְלַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃ וְכֶ֖רֶם רָשָׁ֣ע
verses.transliteration: yaq·ṣī·rū bə·lî·lōw baś·śā·ḏeh yə·laq·qê·šū wə·ḵe·rem rā·šā‘
verses.literal: They gather fodder in the fields and glean the vineyards of the wicked

verses.original: מִבְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ יָ֭לִינוּ עָר֣וֹם וְאֵ֥ין כְּ֝ס֗וּת בַּקָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mib·bə·lî lə·ḇūš yā·lî·nū ‘ā·rō·wm wə·’ên kə·sūṯ baq·qā·rāh
verses.literal: Without clothing they spend the night naked they have no covering against the cold

verses.original: יִרְטָ֑בוּ הָרִ֣ים מִזֶּ֣רֶם חִבְּקוּ־ צֽוּר׃ וּֽמִבְּלִ֥י מַ֝חְסֶ֗ה
verses.transliteration: yir·ṭā·ḇū hā·rîm miz·ze·rem ḥib·bə·qū- ṣūr ū·mib·bə·lî maḥ·seh
verses.literal: Drenched by mountain rains they huddle against the rocks for want of shelter

verses.original: יָת֑וֹם יִ֭גְזְלוּ מִשֹּׁ֣ד וְֽעַל־ עָנִ֥י יַחְבֹּֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ṯō·wm yiḡ·zə·lū miš·šōḏ wə·‘al- ‘ā·nî yaḥ·bō·lū
verses.literal: The fatherless infant is snatched from the breast the nursing child of the poor is seized for a debt

verses.original: בְּלִ֣י לְב֑וּשׁ הִ֭לְּכוּ עָר֣וֹם נָ֣שְׂאוּ עֹֽמֶר׃ וּ֝רְעֵבִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: bə·lî lə·ḇūš hil·lə·ḵū ‘ā·rō·wm nā·śə·’ū ‘ō·mer ū·rə·‘ê·ḇîm
verses.literal: Without clothing they wander about naked They carry the sheaves but still go hungry

verses.original: יַצְהִ֑ירוּ בֵּין־ שׁוּרֹתָ֥ם דָּ֝רְכ֗וּ יְקָבִ֥ים וַיִּצְמָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yaṣ·hî·rū bên- šū·rō·ṯām dā·rə·ḵū yə·qā·ḇîm way·yiṣ·mā·’ū
verses.literal: They crush olives within their walls they tread the winepresses but go thirsty

verses.original: מֵ֘עִ֤יר מְתִ֨ים׀ יִנְאָ֗קוּ וְנֶֽפֶשׁ־ חֲלָלִ֥ים תְּשַׁוֵּ֑עַ וֶ֝אֱל֗וֹהַּ יָשִׂ֥ים לֹא־ תִּפְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·‘îr mə·ṯîm yin·’ā·qū wə·ne·p̄eš- ḥă·lā·lîm tə·šaw·wê·a‘ we·’ĕ·lō·w·ah yā·śîm lō- tip̄·lāh
verses.literal: From the city men groan and the souls of the wounded cry out yet God charges no one with wrongdoing

verses.original: הֵ֤מָּה׀ הָיוּ֮ בְּֽמֹרְדֵ֫י־ א֥וֹר לֹֽא־ הִכִּ֥ירוּ דְרָכָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָ֝שְׁב֗וּ בִּנְתִיבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh hā·yū bə·mō·rə·ḏê- ’ō·wr lō- hik·kî·rū ḏə·rā·ḵāw wə·lō yā·šə·ḇū bin·ṯî·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Then there are those who rebel against the light not knowing its ways . . . or staying on its paths

verses.original: לָא֡וֹר רוֹצֵ֗חַ יָ֘ק֤וּם יִֽקְטָל־ עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן וּ֝בַלַּ֗יְלָה יְהִ֣י כַגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lā·’ō·wr rō·w·ṣê·aḥ yā·qūm yiq·ṭāl- ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn ū·ḇal·lay·lāh yə·hî ḵag·gan·nāḇ
verses.literal: When daylight [is gone] the murderer rises to kill the poor and needy in the night he is like a thief

verses.original: וְעֵ֤ין נֹאֵ֨ף׀ שָׁ֤מְרָֽה נֶ֣שֶׁף לֵ֭אמֹר לֹא־ עָ֑יִן תְשׁוּרֵ֣נִי וְסֵ֖תֶר יָשִֽׂים׃ פָּנִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ên nō·’êp̄ šā·mə·rāh ne·šep̄ lê·mōr lō- ‘ā·yin ṯə·šū·rê·nî wə·sê·ṯer yā·śîm pā·nîm
verses.literal: The eye of the adulterer watches for twilight Thinking No eye will see me he covers . . . his face

verses.original: בַּחֹ֗שֶׁךְ חָתַ֥ר בָּ֫תִּ֥ים יוֹמָ֥ם חִתְּמוּ־ לָ֗מוֹ לֹא־ יָ֥דְעוּ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥō·šeḵ ḥā·ṯar bāt·tîm yō·w·mām ḥit·tə·mū- lā·mōw lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ’ō·wr
verses.literal: In the dark they dig through houses by day they shut themselves in never to experience the light

verses.original: כִּ֤י לָ֣מוֹ צַלְמָ֑וֶת יַחְדָּ֨ו׀ בֹּ֣קֶר כִּֽי־ יַ֝כִּ֗יר בַּלְה֥וֹת צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: kî lā·mōw ṣal·mā·weṯ yaḥ·dāw bō·qer kî- yak·kîr bal·hō·wṯ ṣal·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: For to them deep darkness is their morning surely they are friends with the terrors of darkness

verses.original: ה֤וּא׀ קַֽל־ עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מַ֗יִם חֶלְקָתָ֣ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ תְּקֻלַּ֣ל לֹֽא־ יִ֝פְנֶה דֶּ֣רֶךְ כְּרָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hū qal- ‘al- pə·nê- ma·yim ḥel·qā·ṯām bā·’ā·reṣ tə·qul·lal lō- yip̄·neh de·reḵ kə·rā·mîm
verses.literal: They are but foam on the surface of the water their portion of the land is cursed so that no one turns toward their vineyards

verses.original: צִיָּ֤ה גַם־ חֹ֗ם יִגְזְל֥וּ מֵֽימֵי־ שֶׁ֗לֶג שְׁא֣וֹל חָטָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣî·yāh ḡam- ḥōm yiḡ·zə·lū mê·mê- še·leḡ šə·’ō·wl ḥā·ṭā·’ū
verses.literal: As drought and heat consume vvv the melting snow so Sheol steals those who have sinned

verses.original: רֶ֨חֶם׀ יִשְׁכָּ֘חֵ֤הוּ רִמָּ֗ה מְתָ֘ק֤וֹ יִזָּכֵ֑ר לֹֽא־ ע֥וֹד עַוְלָֽה׃ וַתִּשָּׁבֵ֖ר כָּעֵ֣ץ
verses.transliteration: re·ḥem yiš·kā·ḥê·hū rim·māh mə·ṯā·qōw yiz·zā·ḵêr lō- ‘ō·wḏ ‘aw·lāh wat·tiš·šā·ḇêr kā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: The womb forgets them the worm feeds on them they are remembered no more So injustice is broken like a tree

verses.original: רֹעֶ֣ה עֲ֭קָרָה לֹ֣א תֵלֵ֑ד לֹ֣א יְיֵטִֽיב׃ וְ֝אַלְמָנָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: rō·‘eh ‘ă·qā·rāh lō ṯê·lêḏ lō yə·yê·ṭîḇ wə·’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: They prey on the barren and childless . . . and show no kindness to the widow

verses.original: בְּכֹח֑וֹ וּמָשַׁ֣ךְ אַבִּירִ֣ים יָ֝ק֗וּם וְֽלֹא־ יַאֲמִ֥ין בַּֽחַיִּֽין׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵō·ḥōw ū·mā·šaḵ ’ab·bî·rîm yā·qūm wə·lō- ya·’ă·mîn ba·ḥay·yîn
verses.literal: Yet by His power God drags away the mighty though rising up they have no assurance of life

verses.original: יִתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ לָ֭בֶטַח וְיִשָּׁעֵ֑ן וְ֝עֵינֵ֗יהוּ עַל־ דַּרְכֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yit·ten- lōw lā·ḇe·ṭaḥ wə·yiš·šā·‘ên wə·‘ê·nê·hū ‘al- dar·ḵê·hem
verses.literal: He gives them a sense of security . . . but His eyes are on their ways

verses.original: ר֤וֹמּוּ מְּעַ֨ט׀ וְֽאֵינֶ֗נּוּ וְֽהֻמְּכ֗וּ יִקָּפְצ֑וּן כַּכֹּ֥ל יִמָּֽלוּ׃ וּכְרֹ֖אשׁ שִׁבֹּ֣לֶת
verses.transliteration: rō·wm·mū mə·‘aṭ wə·’ê·nen·nū wə·hum·mə·ḵū yiq·qā·p̄ə·ṣūn kak·kōl yim·mā·lū ū·ḵə·rōš šib·bō·leṯ
verses.literal: They are exalted for a moment then they are gone they are brought low and gathered up like all others they are cut off like heads of grain

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֣א אֵ֭פוֹ מִ֣י יַכְזִיבֵ֑נִי וְיָשֵׂ֥ם מִלָּתִֽי׃ס לְ֝אַ֗ל
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ’ê·p̄ōw mî yaḵ·zî·ḇê·nî wə·yā·śêm mil·lā·ṯî lə·’al
verses.literal: If this is not so then who can prove me a liar and reduce my words to nothing
